notes: Reached via Chrome connector directly, HTTP 200 throughout, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (it is a Shopify Oxygen storefront with an explicit agentic-commerce notice, generically Allow: / for all agents). Westside is a Tata/Trent apparel-led retailer; its Home/Westside Home vertical is textiles and decor only, with no furniture line. Proved absence via three independent checks: (1) Full category-sitemap enumeration -- fetched https://www.westside.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml (same-origin fetch from the loaded page), which lists all 1646 live collection handles on the site. Filtered against a broad furniture keyword list (furnitur, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelv, bookcase, seating, nightstand, armchair, recliner, ottoman, couch, loveseat, tv-unit, storage, rack, trolley, divan, headboard, almirah) -- 29 matches, but on inspection every one is a false positive: all 'wardrobe' hits are apparel wardrobe-styling collections (e.g. 'wardrobe-women-topwear', 'sameera-reddy-wardrobe-reel'), all 'bed' hits are bedsheets/pillow-cases collections, and 'tablescaping' is a decor page. Zero genuine furniture-typed collections (no sofa, chair, dining/coffee/side table, cabinet, bookcase, TV unit, wardrobe-as-furniture, storage furniture, outdoor furniture, etc.) exist anywhere in the sitemap. (2) Discrimination-checked site search: q=furniture -> 0 results ('couldn't find any matches'); q=sofa -> 3 results, all non-furniture fuzzy matches (a perfume, two soft toys); q=chair -> 34 results, all fuzzy-matched to 'chain' jewelry (necklaces/bracelets), zero actual chairs. The differing, non-flat result counts across queries confirm the search engine is not returning a default/constant set, satisfying the false-absence test. (3) Manually inspected the /collections/home landing page (the site's own top-level Home department) -- entirely cushion covers, artificial plants/flowers, lanterns, and decorative glassware; no furniture tiles or facets. This corroborates and extends the prior Home-Decor pass's notes (archive c274), which independently found the same 'Living'/'Kitchen & Dining' collections (Decor, Candle Holders, Vases, Planters, Lighting, Serveware) with no furniture mentioned. Conclusion: Westside Home has no furniture assortment (no beds, sofas, tables, chairs, storage furniture, or any other furniture category) as of 2026-08-24. This is a genuine, well-earned absence, not a search or access failure.
